sentences.text: Shri Santosh Singh Thakur - Ga for respondent/State.

Heard on IA No.2269 of 2023, which is an application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. on behalf of the appellant No.1 Kesharsingh and appellant No.2 Shyamlal for grant of bail and suspension of remaining jail sentence.
Appellants have been convicted under Section 420, 409 of IPC and sentenced to 3-3 years R.I. with fine of Rs.10,000-10,000/-, with usual default stipulation.
Learned counsel for both the appellants contended that the appellants are innocent and they have been falsely implicated in the aforesaid offence.
Appellants were remained on bail during trial and they did not misuse the liberty given to them.
Their jail sentence has already been suspended by the trial Court.
There is a strong case in favour of the appellants.
Final conclusion of appeal will take a long sufficient time.
Hence he prays for grant of bail and suspension of remaining jail sentence of both the appellants.
Per contra, learned GA for the respondent/State opposes the application for suspension of sentence and prays for its rejection.

After considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for both the parties, nature and gravity of the allegation and also taking note of the fact that the appellants were remained on bail during Signature Notthe trial Verified and they did not misuse the liberty given to them and that final Signed by: TRILOK SINGH SAVNER conclusion of this appeal will take a long sufficient time, I deem it proper to Signing time: 21-Feb-23 10:56:24 AM suspend the remaining jail sentence of both the appellants.

Accordingly, IA No.2269 of 2023 is allowed and the execution of remaining jail sentence of the appellant No.1 Kesharsingh and appellant No.2 Shyamlal is hereby suspended till the final disposal of this appeal and it is ordered that the appellants be released on bail on their depositing the fine Kesharsingh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104928710/
1 amount, if not already deposited, and upon furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.75,000/-
each with one solvent surety each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 26.7.2023 and on such other dates,
as may be fixed by the Registry of this Court in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
